title: The Servers
description: Server side mods you should a use when making a Minecraft server. Supports 1.21.8 (1.21.9 support coming soon!)
body:
# Heres what it does
The Servers trys to have the best server side mods you should use when ever you start a Minecraft server while not changing any vanilla mechanics, only expanding on vanilla features. Some of the features in The Servers modpack are more structures, more biomes, better building, more blocks, more enchants, an overhauled end, and much more! Icon was inspired by [Modmenu's](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) banner, so thank you to Modmenu.
